tasks.name: ActionSelection
tasks.description: Map perceptual history to action selection using production system reasoning with if-then rules
tasks.given: agent has production rules in procedural memory, percepts observable from environment, goal defined in working memory
tasks.makes: single action selected and executed, working memory updated with new state

tasks.name: RuleMatchingAndFiring
tasks.description: Match working memory contents against production rule antecedents and fire matching rules
tasks.given: working memory contains percepts and goals in feature-value format, procedural memory contains if-then production rules
tasks.makes: matching rules fire, consequents applied, operators suggested, working memory updated until single operator selected

tasks.name: PitchDecisionMaking
tasks.description: Determine whether to pitch to the batter or intentionally walk the batter based on game situation
tasks.given: pitcher perceives current game state including number of outs, runner positions, and batter characteristics, goal is to escape inning without allowing runs
tasks.makes: decision is made to either pitch or intentionally walk based on strategic situation, appropriate operator is selected

tasks.name: PitchTypeSelection
tasks.description: Choose the specific type of pitch to throw (curveball, fastball, slider) given the decision to pitch
tasks.given: decision to pitch has been made, batter characteristics are known, multiple pitch-type operators are available
tasks.makes: specific pitch type is selected and sent to motor system, pitch-thrown state is added to working memory

tasks.name: ImpasseResolutionThroughLearning
tasks.description: Resolve decision impasse when multiple operators conflict or no operators available by learning new production rule from episodic memory
tasks.given: impasse detected (multiple conflicting operators or no operators), episodic memory contains relevant past events with outcome information
tasks.makes: new production rule created and stored in procedural memory, impasse can be broken in future similar situations

tasks.name: ChunkingLearning
tasks.description: Learn new production rule from episodic memory to break impasse and resolve decision conflict
tasks.given: impasse detected, episodic memory contains relevant past event with similar features and outcome information
tasks.makes: new rule created encapsulating episode knowledge, rule added to procedural memory, impasse broken
